scenes.say: This scam is so famous, it's named after him.
scenes.cap: This scam is so FAMOUS, it's NAMED after him.

scenes.say: Boston, nineteen twenty. Charles Ponzi promised fifty percent profit, in forty-five days.
scenes.cap: Boston, 1920. Charles Ponzi promised 50% PROFIT in 45 DAYS.

scenes.say: His secret? Cheap postal coupons from Europe.
scenes.cap: His secret? Cheap POSTAL COUPONS from Europe.

scenes.say: People lined up with their life savings.
scenes.cap: People lined up with their LIFE SAVINGS.

scenes.say: He bought a mansion. Then a bank.
scenes.cap: He bought a MANSION. Then a BANK.

scenes.say: But he was paying old investors with new investors' money.
scenes.cap: But he was paying OLD investors with NEW investors' money.

scenes.say: A journalist did the math. He'd need a hundred and sixty million coupons.
scenes.cap: A journalist did the MATH. He'd need 160 MILLION coupons.

scenes.say: It collapsed. About twenty million dollars, gone.

upload.title: The Man Behind the Ponzi Scheme 💸 #shorts
upload.description:
In 1920, Charles Ponzi promised 50% profit in 45 days using international postal reply coupons. In reality, he paid old investors with new investors' money. When a journalist did the math, it all collapsed - investors lost about $20 million.

Read more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Ponzi
